Activator (12 M NaOH; silicate/NaOH solution 2.5:1 mass), SNF 2% binder and the ambient curing line are paper-wide statements. They are attached to GPC10 only because it is the one labelled mix; the notes do not say they apply to GPC10 or to the other conditions.
Full binder, aggregate and solution masses are unresolved; no batch, per-m3 or water amounts are recorded.
Curing temperature, curing duration and curing RH are not stated; 7, 14 and 28 days are strength test ages, not curing durations.
Compression, tension and flexure tests and the 28-day acid exposures are named without numbers, so no tests or results are recorded.
Qualitative only: fly-ash-rich mixes resisted acid better and higher slag increased early strength. No mix is named, so no finding or note is recorded.
